# Store assets

Every slot the three stores offer — images and text, required and optional,
including the ones this product deliberately leaves empty and the ones it can
never need.

It exists because a store listing is a form with a few dozen fields and no
store tells you what you forgot. The Microsoft Store poster art was missed
exactly that way, and the omission stayed invisible until someone read the
upload page a second time. Regenerating an asset set from this list cannot
repeat that.

Generated from `brand/store-assets.json`, which is where a new slot goes first.

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **Required** | The store will not publish without it. |
| Recommended | Accepted without it, but a surface degrades. |
| Optional | Accepted without it, nothing degrades. |
| Not applicable | Offered by the store, impossible for this product. |

"Have it" is whether this repository currently fills the slot. Character
limits are what the console enforces, and pixel sizes are what it validates
at upload — none of the three stores resizes anything for you.

## Apple App Store

| | |
|---|---|
| Console | App Store Connect |
| Listing copy | `apps/ios/app-store-listing.md` |
| Asset notes | `brand/app-store/README.md` |
| Locales | no, en-US |

iPhone only. apps/ios/project.yml sets TARGETED_DEVICE_FAMILY to 1, which removes every iPad and Mac slot from the form.

### Images

| Slot | Status | Have it | Spec | Where it lives |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| App icon | **Required** | yes | 1024×1024 · no alpha · ≤ 5 MB | `apps/ios/Sources/QravnApp/Resources/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset` |
| iPhone 6.9" screenshots (no) | **Required** | no | 1320×2868 · 3–10 files · no alpha · ≤ 10 MB | `brand/app-store/screenshots/no` |
| iPhone 6.9" screenshots (en-US) | **Required** | no | 1320×2868 · 3–10 files · no alpha · ≤ 10 MB | `brand/app-store/screenshots/en-US` |
| iPhone 6.5", 6.1" and 5.5" screenshots | Optional | no | — | — |
| iPad 13" and 12.9" screenshots | Not applicable | n/a | — | — |
| App previews | Optional | no | — | — |
| Apple Watch, Mac, Vision Pro and Apple TV screenshots | Not applicable | n/a | — | — |
| Promotional artwork for featuring | Not applicable | n/a | — | — |

- **App icon** — Ships inside the binary; App Store Connect reads it from there and offers no upload field. Generated by tools/gen-ios-appicon.mjs. An alpha channel or baked rounded corners are rejected — iOS applies its own mask.
- **iPhone 6.9" screenshots** — The only screenshot size Apple requires; it downscales this set for every smaller iPhone. Captured by apps/ios/scripts/capture-store-screenshots.sh, which needs macOS.
- **iPhone 6.5", 6.1" and 5.5" screenshots** — Apple derives them from the 6.9" set. Uploading them separately only creates a second set to keep in step.
- **iPad 13" and 12.9" screenshots** — iPhone-only app. The form does not ask.
- **App previews** — Up to three 15-to-30 second videos per size, captured from a device. Not produced: the product is one screen and a verdict, and the screenshots already carry it.
- **Apple Watch, Mac, Vision Pro and Apple TV screenshots** — No such target in apps/ios/project.yml.
- **Promotional artwork for featuring** — Apple requests this directly from the developer when it plans to feature an app. It is not part of a submission and there is no field for it.

### Text and form fields

| Field | Status | Have it | Limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| App name | **Required** | yes | 30 chars |
| Subtitle | Optional | yes | 30 chars |
| Keywords | Optional | yes | 100 chars |
| Promotional text | Optional | yes | 170 chars |
| Description | **Required** | yes | 4000 chars |
| What's New in This Version | **Required** | yes | 4000 chars |
| Privacy Policy URL | **Required** | yes | URL |
| Support URL | **Required** | yes | URL |
| Marketing URL | Optional | yes | URL |
| Copyright | **Required** | yes | free text |
| Primary and secondary category | **Required** | yes | form answer |
| Age rating questionnaire | **Required** | yes | form answer |
| App privacy answers | **Required** | yes | form answer |
| App Review Information notes | Recommended | yes | free text |
| Sign-in information | Not applicable | n/a | form answer |
| License Agreement | Optional | no | free text |

- **App name** — Shown under the icon. Truncates on the home screen long before 30.
- **Subtitle** — One line under the name, and indexed for search. Worth using.
- **Keywords** — Comma separated, 100 characters total including the commas. Never repeat a word from the name or subtitle; those are already indexed.
- **Promotional text** — Above the description, and the one field that can be changed without shipping a build.
- **What's New in This Version** — Required for every update after the first submission.
- **Privacy Policy URL** — Recorded under "## App information" in the listing file.
- **Support URL** — Recorded under "## App information".
- **Copyright** — Year and legal entity. No character limit worth guarding.
- **App privacy answers** — "## App privacy answers" in the listing file. Must agree with Sources/QravnApp/Resources/PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy or the build is rejected.
- **App Review Information notes** — "## Review notes". A reviewer with no QR code to point a camera at is the most likely cause of a 2.1 rejection, so this field is not optional in practice.
- **Sign-in information** — No account, no login, no paid tier.
- **License Agreement** — Apple's standard EULA applies when this is left alone.

## Google Play

| | |
|---|---|
| Console | Play Console |
| Listing copy | `apps/android/play-listing.md` |
| Asset notes | `apps/android/README.md` |
| Locales | nb-NO (default), en-US |

Phone form factor only. The alpha rule is the one to watch: the icon is the single Play asset allowed to carry a transparency channel.

### Images

| Slot | Status | Have it | Spec | Where it lives |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| App icon | **Required** | yes | 512×512 · ≤ 1 MB | `brand/play` |
| Feature graphic | **Required** | yes | 1024×500 · 24-bit · no alpha · ≤ 15 MB | `brand/play` |
| Phone screenshots (en-US) | **Required** | yes | 1080×1920 · 2–8 files · 24-bit · no alpha · ≤ 8 MB | `brand/play/screenshots/en-US` |
| Phone screenshots (nb-NO) | **Required** | yes | 1080×1920 · 2–8 files · 24-bit · no alpha · ≤ 8 MB | `brand/play/screenshots/nb-NO` |
| 7-inch and 10-inch tablet screenshots | Optional | no | — | — |
| Android TV banner and screenshots | Not applicable | n/a | — | — |
| Wear OS, Android Auto and XR screenshots | Not applicable | n/a | — | — |
| Preview video | Optional | no | — | — |

- **App icon** — 32-bit PNG with alpha, at most 1024 KB. Play applies its own rounded corners and shadow, so the source is a full square.
- **Feature graphic** — 24-bit PNG or JPEG, no alpha. Play cannot publish a listing without it. Edges get cropped in some placements, so nothing load-bearing goes near them.
- **Phone screenshots** — JPEG or 24-bit PNG, no alpha, between 320 and 3840 px per side, and the long side may not exceed twice the short side. The emulator's native 1080x2400 is 2.22 and is rejected; captures are taken after `adb shell wm size 1080x1920`.
- **7-inch and 10-inch tablet screenshots** — Required only for an app that declares tablet support. Becomes required the moment large-screen support is claimed.
- **Android TV banner and screenshots** — Not distributed to TV. A TV listing needs a 1280x720 banner and at least one TV screenshot.
- **Wear OS, Android Auto and XR screenshots** — No such distribution. Each has its own mandatory shape and count.
- **Preview video** — A YouTube URL rather than an upload. Not produced.

### Text and form fields

| Field | Status | Have it | Limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| App name | **Required** | yes | 30 chars |
| Short description | **Required** | yes | 80 chars |
| Full description | **Required** | yes | 4000 chars |
| Release notes | **Required** | yes | 500 chars |
| Privacy policy URL | **Required** | yes | URL |
| Support email | **Required** | yes | URL |
| Category and tags | **Required** | yes | form answer |
| Content rating questionnaire | **Required** | yes | form answer |
| Data safety declaration | **Required** | yes | form answer |
| App content declarations | **Required** | yes | form answer |
| Store settings | **Required** | yes | form answer |

- **Short description** — The first text a customer reads, and it appears without the full description in several surfaces.
- **Release notes** — Per language, per release. Much shorter than the Apple and Microsoft equivalents, which is the usual reason a shared draft does not fit.
- **Support email** — Play requires a contact email; the website and phone are optional.
- **Content rating questionnaire** — "## Content rating questionnaire" in the listing file.
- **Data safety declaration** — "## Data safety declaration". Must agree with the manifest: the app declares no INTERNET permission, so every collection answer is no.
- **App content declarations** — Ads, target audience, news, COVID-19, data safety, government apps, financial features.
- **Store settings** — "## Store settings": app category, contact details, external marketing opt-out.

## Microsoft Store

| | |
|---|---|
| Console | Partner Center |
| Listing copy | `brand/microsoft-store/store-listing.md` |
| Asset notes | `brand/microsoft-store/README.md` |
| Locales | en-US, nb-NO |

Submitted as a PWA. Partner Center offers the largest form of the three and almost all of it is optional, which is precisely why a written list is needed.

### Images

| Slot | Status | Have it | Spec | Where it lives |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Screenshots (en-US) | **Required** | yes | 1920×1080 · 1–30 files · ≤ 50 MB | `brand/microsoft-store/screenshots/en-US` |
| Screenshots (nb-NO) | **Required** | yes | 1920×1080 · 1–30 files · ≤ 50 MB | `brand/microsoft-store/screenshots/nb-NO` |
| Store logos: app tile icon, 1:1 | Recommended | yes | 300×300 · ≤ 5 MB | `brand/microsoft-store/logos` |
| Store logos: 150x150 and 71x71, 1:1 | Recommended | yes | 150×150, 71×71 · ≤ 5 MB | `brand/microsoft-store/logos` |
| Store logos: poster art, labelled 9:16 | Recommended | yes | 720×1080, 1440×2160 · ≤ 50 MB | `brand/microsoft-store/logos` |
| Store logos: box art, 1:1 | Recommended | yes | 1080×1080, 2160×2160 · ≤ 50 MB | `brand/microsoft-store/logos` |
| Super hero art, 16:9 | Optional | yes | 1920×1080, 3840×2160 · ≤ 50 MB | `brand/microsoft-store/hero` |
| Xbox branded key art | Optional | yes | 584×800 · ≤ 50 MB | `brand/microsoft-store/hero` |
| Xbox titled hero art | Optional | yes | 1920×1080 · ≤ 50 MB | `brand/microsoft-store/hero` |
| Xbox featured promotional square art | Optional | yes | 1080×1080 · ≤ 50 MB | `brand/microsoft-store/hero` |
| Trailers | Optional | no | — | — |

- **Screenshots** — At least one. The store asks for 1366x768 or larger and accepts up to 3840x2160; these are rendered at 1920x1080 by tools/store-shots/capture.mjs.
- **Store logos: app tile icon, 1:1** — Partner Center falls back to the logos inside the package when these are absent. A PWA package has no good source for them, so they are supplied.
- **Store logos: poster art, labelled 9:16** — The main logo for Windows 10 and 11 customers, and required for Xbox display. Partner Center labels the slot 9:16 and then demands 720x1080 and 1440x2160, which are 2:3. Follow the pixels: a true 9:16 asset is rejected at upload.
- **Store logos: box art, 1:1** — Used across several Store layouts, and becomes the main logo when poster art is absent. Carries the wordmark, which is what separates it from the identically sized Xbox promotional square.
- **Super hero art, 16:9** — Top of the listing on Windows 10 1607 and later. Must not contain the product's title, and is required if a trailer is to play at the top of the listing.
- **Xbox branded key art** — Must carry the title in the top three quarters; text overlays may cover the bottom quarter.
- **Xbox titled hero art** — Same title rule as the branded key art.
- **Xbox featured promotional square art** — Must not carry the title, which is the opposite of the two Xbox slots above and the reason this is not the same file as box-art-1080x1080.png.
- **Trailers** — Uploaded video with its own thumbnail. Not produced. Super hero art is required before a trailer can head the listing.

### Text and form fields

| Field | Status | Have it | Limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Product name | **Required** | yes | 256 chars |
| Description | **Required** | yes | 10000 chars |
| Short description | Optional | yes | 1000 chars |
| Product features | Optional | yes | 200 chars × 20 items |
| Search terms | Optional | yes | 30 chars × 7 lines · 21 words total |
| What's new in this version | Optional | no | 1500 chars |
| Short title | Optional | no | 50 chars |
| Sort title | Optional | no | 255 chars |
| Voice title | Optional | no | 255 chars |
| Copyright and trademark info | Optional | no | 200 chars |
| Additional license terms | Optional | no | 10000 chars |
| Developed by | Optional | no | 255 chars |
| Additional system requirements | Optional | no | free text |
| Privacy policy URL | **Required** | yes | URL |
| Support contact info | **Required** | yes | URL |
| Website | Optional | yes | URL |
| Category and subcategory | **Required** | yes | form answer |
| Age ratings questionnaire | **Required** | yes | form answer |
| Markets, pricing and availability | **Required** | yes | form answer |
| Product declarations | **Required** | yes | form answer |

- **Product name** — Reserved once for the whole product; the per-locale field selects among reserved names.
- **Short description** — Used in search results and on smaller surfaces. Far longer than the Play field of the same name.
- **Product features** — Up to 20 bullets of 200 characters, shown as a list.
- **Search terms** — Seven terms, 30 characters each, and 21 individual words across all of them. Not shown to customers. A term made only of words already in the name or description is wasted, because those fields are indexed anyway.
- **What's new in this version** — Deliberately blank: this is the first submission and there is nothing to be new against.
- **Short title** — A shorter name for tiles where the full one does not fit. The product name is 26 to 28 characters, so it already fits.
- **Sort title** — For a name that sorts badly. "QRavn" does not.
- **Voice title** — An alternate name for spoken requests.
- **Additional license terms** — The Standard Application License Terms apply when this is left alone.
- **Additional system requirements** — Free text for hardware the app needs. A camera is already implied by the product.
- **Privacy policy URL** — Required for any product that connects to the network or collects anything, and Partner Center asks regardless.
- **Markets, pricing and availability** — "## Properties and Store settings" in the listing file.
- **Product declarations** — Accessibility, notifications, hardware requirements and the rest of the Properties page.

## Keeping this true

- `brand/store-assets.json` is the source. This document is generated from it.
- `node tools/gen-store-assets-doc.mjs` rewrites this file.
- `node tools/gen-store-assets-doc.mjs --check` fails when the two disagree, and runs in CI.
- `node tools/check-store-images.mjs` measures every image slot that has files against its row above.
- `node tools/check-store-listings.mjs` measures every character-limited text field and cross-checks it against the registry.

The URL, email and form-answer rows are not machine-checked — no store
publishes a schema for them. They are here so the form gets filled in
completely, and the listing files hold the answers to copy across.

Adding a slot means adding it to the registry first. The checkers and this
document follow from that, which is the point: a slot that is not in the
registry is a slot nobody is going to remember at submission time.
